title: Règne Delta: 2 days to go (Fri 6 Nov); the online game gets it tomorrow
detail: Worldwide release 6 Nov, Pokémon TCG Live from 5 Nov. Mega Rayquaza ex is the headliner. US box price was about $240 on the market in mid-October (not a French or Réunion price).

title: Miyata Kard Market now lists Règne Delta pre-orders (Réunion)
detail: Listed prices: Bundle 6 boosters €44.99 (arrives 17 Nov, in stock), Elite Trainer Box €79.99 and 3-pack blister €19.99 (both shown sold out), Display 36 boosters €239.99 and single booster €7.99 (stock status unclear on the page). Many items are a 'second wave' arriving 17 Nov, not 6 Nov. Check with the shop before relying on it.

title: Mega Darkrai ex SIR (Pitch Black) still steady
detail: Cardmarket 7-day average €180 vs 30-day €184 (updated 3 Nov). No alert. Other cards could not be checked: the collection file has no card IDs.

title: OP-18: nothing new; Japan date still reported as 22 Nov, English date not announced
detail: Card reveals continue on the official X account. Sources disagree on the Japanese day (21 vs 22 Nov), so the Calendar date stays unconfirmed.

title: Regionals Porto and Sydney are this Saturday, 7 Nov
detail: Still upcoming, no results yet. Pokémon: no event finished since yesterday.
